evidence: The George Sound Route requires transport across Lake Te Anau
The route from Lake Katherine to George Sound Hut (6 bunks) takes between 1 and 2 hours.

doubts: The start is the track end on the Middle Fiord reached by boat across Lake Te Anau; no feature for it. The crossing of Lake Hankinson is by boat (or kayak) and is listed as a via without a how. The two 'three-wire' crossings are unnamed wire crossings (not recorded as fords). Katherine Creek is unbridged but the text only says to follow it. The text says George Sound is accessible by boat, float plane and helicopter; recorded as exits from the end hut.
